title: A Character Riddle
synopsis: Can you figure out the answer to this Chinese riddle involving a door?

fullText.simplified:
字谜

    很早以前，村子里有个有钱人，他觉得自己家的门不够好，决定拆掉重建。为了建好这个大门，他用了很多的工人。门刚建了一半，他就来看，看完之后，一句话都没说，只在门上写了个“活”字就离开了。
    工人们都看出他不满意了，但是没人知道他写“活”这个字的目的。大家都怕得不到钱，但是却不知道怎么办。就在大家着急害怕的时候，村子里最聪明的人走了过来，看了看门上的字，让人马上把门拆了，再把门建小一点。
    很多人都不明白为什么，就问他为什么这样做。他说：“门里加个‘活’字，是‘阔’字。“阔”是大的意思。有钱人是嫌门大了，所以要把门改小。”
fullText.traditional:
字謎

    很早以前，村子裡有個有錢人，他覺得自己家的門不夠好，決定拆掉重建。為了建好這個大門，他用了很多的工人。門剛建了一半，他就來看，看完之後，一句話都沒說，只在門上寫了個“活”字就離開了。
    工人們都看出他不滿意了，但是沒人知道他寫“活”這個字的目的。大家都怕得不到錢，但是卻不知道怎麼辦。就在大家著急害怕的時候，村子裡最聰明的人走了過來，看了看門上的字，讓人馬上把門拆了，再把門建小一點。
    很多人都不明白為什麼，就問他為什麼這樣做。他說：“門裡加個‘活’字，是‘闊’字。“闊”是大的意思。有錢人是嫌門大了，所以要把門改小。”

raw.synopsis: Can you figure out the answer to this Chinese riddle involving a door?
sentence_translations: A long time ago, a rich man lived in a village.
He thought that the front door to his house was not good enough, so he decided to tear it down and rebuild it.
In order to build this front door, he hired many workers.
When the door was barely halfway finished, he came to look at it.
After he finished looking, he did not say a word; he simply wrote the character for “alive” on the door, and left.
The workers could all see that he was not pleased, but no one knew the purpose of writing the character for “alive”.
Everyone was afraid of not getting paid for their work, but no one knew what to do.
As everyone was panicking, the smartest person in the village walked over and glanced at the character on the door.
He told people to take the door down immediately, and then build a smaller one.
A lot of people didn’t understand why, so they asked him why they needed to do this.
He replied, “The character ‘alive’ written inside a ‘door’ makes the character ‘wide’. ‘Wide’ means big.
The rich person is dissatisfied that the door is too big, so the door needs to be made smaller.”
